Name: Ken
Text: You can play low kicks and low projectiles as high kicks and high projectiles and vice versa. (*) When you play a kick or projectile, you may switch a card in your hand with the top card of your deck.

Name: Ryu
Text: Your rival discards +1 card from his deck when your other effects discard cards from his deck. (*) Your first projectile each turn costs -1 energy for each punch in your energy pile.

Name: Blanka
Text: Your electrics deal +2 damage.  (*) Twice per step you may pay +1 energy to change a punch into an electric.

Name: Chun Li
Text: Kicks you perform can link into kicks.  (*) The 3rd kick you play in each combo gains Launcher.

Name: Dhalsim
Text: When your last attack in a combo of 3 or more attacks hits, search your discard pile for a card and place it into your energy pile.

Name: E. Honda
Text: Your punches and slams deal +2 chipping.  (*) Twice per step when you perform a slam you may draw a block from your discard pile.

Name: Guile
Text: The first time you end a combo with a projectile each step you may draw a card.  (*) Your projectiles deal +1 damage.

Name: Zangief
Text: You may discard a card from your hand to block a throw.  (*) Throws you perform that end a combo of 4 or more attacks are unblockable.

Name: Footsies
Text: Flip when you attack.  Your 0 and 1 cost attacks are unblockable this action.

Name: Good Read
Text: Flip when your rival attacks before you play a block.  Look at the top 3 cards of your deck.  Put 1 of those cards in your hand and the other 2 on the bottom of your deck.  (*) Limit 1 per deck.

Name: Psycho Power
Text: STREET FIGHTER ONLY - Flip at the start of Battle.  Draw 3 cards, then place 2 cards from your hand on top of your deck.  (*) Remove this card.  (*) Limit 1 per deck.

Name: Blanka's Rolling Attack
Text: Counts as a punch.

Name: Chun Li's Hyakuretsukyaku
Text: If your rival is launched when you play this attack, this attack stays in the arena to be used a 2nd time this step.  If it's in the arena when Battle ends, discard it.

Name: Chun Li's Senretsukyaku
Text: This attack does +1 damage for each kick you’ve played this step.

Name: Chun Li's Spinning Bird Kick
Text: If your rival is launched when you play this attack, take 1 card from their energy pile and place it in their discard pile.

Name: Dhalsim's Yoga Fire
Text: HIT - Search your discard pile for a card and place it into your energy pile.

Name: Dhalsim's Yoga Inferno
Text: HIT - Prevent 4 damage from each of your rival’s attacks this step.

Name: E. Honda's Hundred Hand Slap
Text: This attack stays in the arena to be used a second and third time this step. If it's in the arena when Battle ends, discard it.

Name: E. Honda's Sumo Headbutt
Text: You may discard a block from your hand when you perform this attack to have it deal +4 damage.

Name: E. Honda's Super Killer Head Ram
Text: You may discard a block from your hand when you perform this attack to have it deal +8 damage.

Name: Guile's Sonic Hurricane
Text: This attack does +6 chipping.

Name: Zangief's Banishing Flat
Text: HIT - Your rival’s projectiles deal 0 damage during their next action.

Name: Zangief's Final Atomic Buster
Text: If you have performed at least 3 other throws this step this attack does +5 damage.  (*) HIT - Your rival must pass in their next action this step.

Name: Zangief's Spinning Piledriver
Text: HIT - Your rival’s next attack this step costs +1 energy.

Name: Blanka's Electric Thunder
Text: This attack stays in the arena to be used a 2nd time this step.  If it's in the arena when Battle ends, discard it.

Name: Blanka's Ground Shave Roll
Text: If you have performed 2 other electrics this step this attack deals +6 damage.

Name: Dhalsim's Yoga Teleport
Text: End your rival’s action.  (*) If your next attack is a projectile it is unblockable.

Name: Alex's Air Stampede
Text: Your rival's next attack this step does -6 damage.

Name: Dudley's Machine Gun Blow
Text: If you flip an event when you perform this attack it deals +4 damage.

Name: Hugo's Giant Palm Bomber
Text: Your rival’s next attack this step costs +1 energy.

Name: Ibuki's Kunai
Text: The next time your rival would draw a card this step they discard it instead.

Name: Ken's Hurricane Kick
Text: You may play this card to block a projectile.  (*) When played as a block you may switch another card in your hand with the top card of your deck instead of paying this card’s energy cost.

Name: Ryu's Hadoken
Text: Your rival discards the top two cards of their deck. (*) This attack loses its name when in your energy pile.

Name: Sean's Dragon Smash
Text: If your rival has 5 or more energy they cannot gain energy from their next attack this step.

Name: Twelve's A.X.E.
Text: Set an event from your energy pile.

Name: Elena's Rhino Horn
Text: Heal 2 from the bottom of your discards.

Name: Alex's Air Stampede EX
Text: HIT - Your rival's attacks deal -2 damage this step.

Name: Blanka's Rolling Attack EX
Text: Counts as an electric.

Name: Chun-li's Spinning Bird Kick EX
Text: HIT - Your Launchers deal +2 damage this step.

Name: Dhalsim's Yoga Fire EX
Text: HIT - Your projectiles cost -2 energy this step.

Name: Dudley's Machine Gun Blow EX
Text: When you flip an event this step your rival discards the top 2 cards of their deck.

Name: E. Honda's Sumo Headbut EX
Text: You may reveal a block from your hand when you perform this attack to have it deal +4 damage.

Name: Gill's Cyber Lariat EX
Text: HIT - Your attacks count as being +1 cost for your effects this step.

Name: Guile's Flash Kick EX
Text: HIT - Search your discard pile for a projectile and draw it.

Name: Hugo's Giant Palm Bomber EX
Text: All of your rival’s attacks cost +1 during their next combo.

Name: Ibuki's Kuna EX
Text: HIT - Your rival may not draw cards this step.

Name: Ken's Hurricane Kick EX
Text: Switch any number of cards from your hand with cards from the top of your deck.

Name: Ryu's Hadoken EX
Text: Your rival discards the top 4 cards of their deck.

Name: Sean's Dragon Smash EX
Text: HIT - If your rival has 5 or more energy they cannot gain energy this step.

Name: Twelve's A.X.E EX
Text: Set any number of events from your energy pile.

Name: Zangief's Banishing Flat EX
Text: HIT - Your rival's projectiles deal 0 damage this step.

Name: Elena's Rhino Horn EX
Text: When you Heal this step during a combo double the healing amount.
